intro: Requests that wait for your yes, your own requests and recent decisions. In this release: quote approvals.
keys: Keys: Tab to a request, Enter — open it · in the review: A — approve, R — reject, J / K — next / previous, Esc — close.

waiting.title: Nothing waits for your yes.
waiting.body: When a quote breaks a rule and someone asks, it appears here.

mine.title: You have no open requests.
mine.body: Requests you ask from a quote appear here until someone decides.

decided.title: Nothing decided in the last 7 days.
decided.body: Decisions you made, and decisions on your requests, appear here.

held.OWN_REQUEST: You asked for this: another approver decides.
held.NO_RIGHT: Your role does not approve quotes.
held.NEEDS_MARGIN: About the margin: an approver who sees margins decides.
held.changed: Changed since asked: open the quote and ask again.

review.title: Approve quote {number}?
review.not_found: This request is not in this view any more: it may have been decided or withdrawn.
review.forbidden: You may not open this quote.
review.changed: Changed since asked: the quote is no longer the one asked about.
review.noRule: No rule is broken now: the request may be out of date.
review.noMargin: Margin figures are not shown for your role.

rule.MARGIN_FLOOR: The margin is under the floor.
rule.DISCOUNT_LIMIT: A discount is over the {limit} limit.
rule.AMOUNT_LIMIT: The amount is over the limit.

rejectDialog.title: Reject — tell {who} why
rejectDialog.body: The quote goes back to Draft; your reason lands in its history for the person who asked.

notice.approved: {number} approved. The next request is open.
notice.forbidden: Not decided: you may not decide this request (your own, or a margin request without margin rights).
